title: CodeChef: Distinct Colors
description: There are `n` different colors of balls. Array `a` contains counts of balls of each color. What is the maximum number of balls of any single color (i.e. minimum boxes needed to ensure distinct colors)?
solution:
def distinct_colors(a: list[int]) -> int:
    return max(a)
explanation: By Pigeonhole principle, max frequency dictates necessary partition boxes in O(N) time.
